instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): enb_date = input(false ,"Enable Date Range?", type = input.bool, inline = "1"); enb_current = input(true ,"Today as End Date" , type = input.bool, inline = "1"); i_start_date = input(timestamp("01 Jan 2021 00:00 +0300") ,"Start Date" , type=input.time); i_end_date = input(timestamp("16 July 2021 00:00 +0300") ,"End Date" , type=input.time); i_vwma_length = input(50, "VWMA Length" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings", inline = "2"); i_sma_length = input(50, "SMA Length" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings", inline = "2"); i_stoch_length = input(28, "Stoch Length" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings", inline = "3"); i_mfi_length = input(7 , "MFI Length" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings", inline = "3"); i_obv_length = input(100, "OBV Length" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings"); i_atr_len = input(100, "ATR Ranging-trend len" ,type = input.integer, group = "Indicator Settings", tooltip = "This is the length of the ATR Emas that check when the market in a general trend or is just ranging"); i_div_price = input(5 ,"Price Divergant Pivots" ,type = input.integer, group = "Divergance Settings"); i_inacc = input(0.05 ,"Price Inaccuracy" ,type = input.float , group = "Divergance Settings"); i_div_length = input(3 ,"Divergance Valid Period" ,type = input.integer, group = "Divergance Settings"); i_mfi_left = input(5 ,"MFI Left/Right Pivots" ,type = input.integer, group = "Divergance Settings", inline = "4"); i_mfi_right = input(2 ,"" ,type = input.integer, group = "Divergance Settings", inline = "4"); tp_percentage = input(10 , "TP Percentage" ,type = input.float , group = "Exit Settings")/100; _inacc = input(0.03, "Support Inaccuracy" ,type = input.float, step = 0.01, group = "Exit Settings"); enb_stoch_mfi = input(true, "Use Stoch/MFI Trend" , type = input.bool, group = "Individual Entries") | Indicator calls: pivothigh(high,20,20); pivotlow(low,20,20); stoch(close, high, low, i_stoch_length); sma(close,i_sma_length); ema((atr(14); pivothigh(high, i_div_price,i_div_price); pivotlow(low,i_div_price,i_div_price); pivothigh(s_mfi, i_mfi_left,i_mfi_right); pivotlow(s_mfi, i_mfi_left,i_mfi_right); highest(nz(mh); ema(obv,100)
exit: Source rule: strategy.position_size  exceeds  0; order: strategy.exit("Buy", limit = tpprice, comment = "TP"); Source rule: close  is at most  previousRes; order: strategy.exit("Buy", stop = previousRes, comment = "SL")
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Pivot/fractal conditions can be confirmed only after right-side bars; confirm signal timestamp and avoid hindsight fills.
